ComparisonStartRequest.description:
One scenario run twice at once, ER Green Wave enabled and disabled, in lockstep (ADR 0008).

The fields are those of :class:`SimulationStartRequest` minus ``green_wave_mode``; each run
keeps its own client-chosen id and is streamed and stopped like a single run.
ComparisonStartRequest.title: ComparisonStartRequest

GreenWaveMode.description: Whether the run pre-empts signals (``ENABLED``) or crosses them in standard traffic.
GreenWaveMode.title: GreenWaveMode

IntersectionState.description: ``CLEARING_CASCADE`` is not a state: a cascaded one is ``CLEARING`` + ``is_cascade``.
IntersectionState.title: IntersectionState

OnFootLeg.description: The walk from the vehicle's access point to an incident off the routable network.
OnFootLeg.title: OnFootLeg

SignalPhaseIndicator.description: One simulated signal indication at a known signal position; never a live signal state.
SignalPhaseIndicator.title: SignalPhaseIndicator

SimulationStreamEvent.description:
Any event on the SSE stream, discriminated on ``event_type``.

A RootModel (not a bare alias) so the union is a named OpenAPI component and the frontend
gets a named ``SimulationStreamEvent`` type.
SimulationStreamEvent.title: SimulationStreamEvent

StationSourceKind.description: Where a station comes from; the UI names it, so hospital EDs are not passed off as bases.
StationSourceKind.title: StationSourceKind

VehicleType.description:
Chooses the candidate stations and the map icon, and is reported in the ITS payload.

Lives here, not in ``schemas.dispatch``, because the start request and the ITS payload use it
and ``schemas.dispatch`` imports from this module (ADR 0006).
VehicleType.title: VehicleType

get.description: The ``data_quality.json`` summary loaded at startup, unchanged (no recomputation).

post.description: Sync on purpose: FastAPI runs it in the thread pool, keeping the CPU work off the loop.

post.description:
Start the ER Green Wave and standard-traffic runs of one scenario in lockstep (ADR 0008).

Supersedes the active run or pair; each run streams and stops under its own id, and stopping
either stops both.
